crossRefs.note: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.

translations.web: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
translations.bsb: For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
translations.kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
translations.asv: For a harlot is a deep ditch; And a foreign woman is a narrow pit.
